integrity: All analytical steps and finite reproducibility checks are supplied. Numerical experiments corroborate but do not prove asymptotics. Earlier results are explicitly distinguished, and no claim of independent validation or complete historical priority is made.
limitations: Only planar central sections of the unit three-dimensional cross-polytope under Haar orientation. No complete elementary CDF, no translated planes, and no higher-dimensional extension proved. Historical priority provisional because potentially related older section literature is not fully inspected.
title: An interior logarithmic singularity and two sharp endpoint laws for random octahedron sections
